title: Petra and the Witness
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Bram Sandoval, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
